meta.peakNote: Peak values are theoretical NVIDIA datasheet specifications, not benchmarked ceilings. Percentages compare measured useful throughput with the corresponding dense theoretical peak.
meta.timingNote: CUDA graphs; maximum rank in each window, then median of five windows of 30 iterations. Forward, backward, and combined medians are reduced separately.
meta.bandwidthNote: NVLink TX/RX are hardware counters from a separate collection of at least one second. HBM is an analytical useful-byte estimate, not a DRAM-counter measurement.
meta.placementNote: Four separate allocations. EP64 training ran at a different site from EP32. Some allocations shared an NVLink fabric and overlapped in lifetime; timing-window overlap is unconfirmed. These observations do not establish uncontended peak performance.
meta.memoryNote: One layer; training has one activation slot and capacity/scratch factors 8. VMM is off and no training layer triggered capacity recompute. Arena budgets and PyTorch allocation peaks are separate accounting views.
